fable5.template:
Execute Fable 5 plan tasks from the master backlog.

Project root: /Users/scmessenger/Documents/Github/SCMessenger_Clean
Plan file: fable5plan.md

## Task Execution Protocol

1. Read fable5plan.md to identify the next task in dependency order
2. Check task dependencies are satisfied (prior tasks completed)
3. Switch to the appropriate agent based on task type:
   - Track 5 (CI/hygiene) → rust-coder agent
   - Track 1 (Transport) → rust-coder + mobile-dev agents
   - Track 2 (DTN) → rust-coder agent
   - Track 3 (Routing) → rust-coder agent
   - Track 4 (Crypto/UI) → rust-coder + mobile-dev agents
4. Execute the task following the Implementation section exactly
5. Run the Verification section checks
6. Mark task complete and move to next

## Dependency Graph
T5.1 → T5.2 → T5.3 → T5.4 → T5.5 → T5.6
                ↘ T5.7 (after T5.5 artifacts)
T5.8, T5.9 — parallel anytime after T5.1

T1.1 (requires T5.7 gate live) → T1.2 → T1.3
                               → T1.4
T1.5, T1.6 — parallel after T5.4
T1.7 after T1.1

T2.1 — after T5.4
T2.2 — after T2.1
T2.3 — after T2.2
T2.4 — after T2.3 + T1.6
T2.5 — after T2.3

T3.1 — after T5.4
T3.2 — after T3.1
T3.3 — after T2.5 + T3.1
T3.4 — after T3.3

T4.1 — after T5.4
T4.2 — after T5.7
T4.3 — after T2.3
T4.4 — after T5.7
T4.5 — after T4.1

gatekeeper.template:
Gatekeeper review for SCMessenger_Clean workspace.

This command ensures only verified, clean code enters the SCMessenger_Clean workspace.
The pre-existing SCMessenger repo is the working workspace for consolidation/pruning.

## Gatekeeper Protocol

1. Run `cargo check --workspace` on the clean workspace
2. Run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -- -D warnings`
3. Run `cargo fmt --check`
4. Run `cargo test --workspace` (non-ignored tests)
5. Verify no build artifacts committed: `git ls-files | grep -E '\.(so|dylib|apk)$'` returns empty
6. Verify no hardcoded paths: `grep -r 'kanal\|Users\\' core/.cargo/` returns empty
7. If all checks pass, approve the update
8. If any check fails, reject and report the specific failure

## Workspace Distinction
- SCMessenger_Clean: Gatekeeper-approved only. This is the production workspace.
- SCMessenger: Pre-existing repo. Working workspace for development, consolidation, pruning.

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS

orchestrate.template:
SCMessenger Swarm Orchestrator for MiMo Code.

Delegates work to subagents using MiMo Code's native subagent system.
No external scripts needed — uses MiMo Code's built-in agent orchestration.

## Orchestration Protocol

1. Read fable5plan.md to identify available tasks
2. Check task dependencies
3. Spawn subagents using MiMo Code's agent system:
   - Use `build` agent for implementation tasks
   - Use `plan` agent for analysis tasks
   - Use `reviewer` agent for verification tasks
4. Monitor subagent progress via task tracking
5. Run gatekeeper checks on completion
6. Update task status

## Dynamic Pacing
- MiMo Auto (free): Use for all tasks, no quota concerns
- OpenRouter/xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro: Primary model for complex tasks
- OpenRouter fallbacks: claude-opus-4.8 for critical architecture decisions

## Operational Rules
- Max 3 concurrent subagents
- Verify after each completion: cargo check, cargo test
- Git commit after each verified task completion
- Never push without explicit user approval

Arguments: $ARGUMENTS
